title: Signs You're Still Growing
mascot_sheet: Full body character model sheet of Tapey, a friendly yellow bendy coiled measuring tape cartoon character with big expressive anime-style eyes, tiny red sneakers on stubby legs, wearing a backwards blue baseball cap, simple black bold outlines, flat vibrant colors, plain white background
voice: fast, punchy, playful teenage explainer delivery
music: upbeat bouncy 8-bit cartoon acoustic beat, 125 BPM, light and cheerful

scenes.vo: Your body gives signs. Are you still growing?
scenes.bg: bright sunny yellow backdrop with radiating light rays
scenes.pose: Tapey leaning forward inquisitively, tapping chin with one yellow ribbon arm, wide curious eyes, tilted blue cap

props.prompt: cartoon magnifying glass with shiny glass reflection

scenes.vo: First clue: your shoes suddenly feel super tight.
scenes.bg: pastel teal bedroom floor pattern with scattered shoe boxes
scenes.pose: Tapey sitting down clutching one tiny sneaker, wincing comically as toes burst through the tip

props.prompt: flying comic sweat drops and exclamation mark

scenes.vo: Your favorite pants now show your bare ankles.
scenes.bg: minimalist warm orange gradient with subtle geometric shapes
scenes.pose: Tapey standing tall, looking down embarrassed at cartoon blue jeans that end way above the knees

props.prompt: red dashed measurement arrow pointing up from ankle

scenes.vo: You are suddenly starving and sleepy all day.
scenes.bg: cozy light purple cartoon kitchen background
scenes.pose: Tapey drooling happily with half-closed sleepy eyes, cradling a giant cartoon sandwich in both hands

scenes.vo: Achy knees at night often signal growth plates.
scenes.bg: soft navy blue nighttime room with crescent moon pattern
scenes.pose: Tapey rubbing knees in a silly dramatic grimace while curled up on a pillow

props.prompt: sparkling golden bone icon with glowing aura

scenes.vo: Want to know what is left? Don't guess!
scenes.bg: bold split lime green and cyan graphic background
scenes.pose: Tapey pointing directly at the camera with a confident wink, hand on hip

props.prompt: stylized cartoon smartphone displaying a growth chart graph

scenes.vo: And there's way more inside our app.
scenes.bg: vibrant sky blue gradient with floating fluffy white clouds
scenes.pose: Tapey jumping joyfully mid-air, both ribbon arms stretched overhead in victory

props.prompt: colorful floating checkmarks and star badges

scenes.vo: Get your personal routine in TallPlan.
scenes.bg: clean bright yellow and white radial sunburst pattern
scenes.pose: Tapey proudly holding up the TallPlan app icon badge like a gold medal, beaming smile

props.prompt: download badge icon with green checkmark
